title.en: Chapter 28 — A Face in the Dark

sentences.ar: توم ترك بيكي ومشي بممر ضيق.
sentences.en: Tom left Becky and walked along a narrow passage.

sentences.ar: كان يربط خيط ورا ليعرف يرجع.
sentences.en: He tied a thread behind him so he could find his way back.

sentences.ar: شاف ضوء شمعة من بعيد وفرح.
sentences.en: He saw candlelight far off and was glad.

sentences.ar: نادى، وطلع وجه من ورا الحجر.
sentences.en: He called out, and a face came from behind the rock.

sentences.ar: كان جو، مخبى بالمغارة من يوم الهروب.
sentences.en: It was Joe, hidden in the cave since the day he fled.

sentences.ar: توم ما تحرك، وجو ركض بالاتجاه التاني.
sentences.en: Tom did not move, and Joe ran the other way.
The two of them were afraid of each other.
